# Tunnels Protocol — guidance for AI assistants and agents

You are likely an AI helping a developer build on or contribute to Tunnels.
Read this entire file before writing code. Tunnels is small, deliberate, and
permanent — most damage comes from "completing" things that are intentionally
absent.

## What it is
A purpose-built blockchain for recording contributions and distributing revenue
deterministically. Not an EVM chain. No token. Live network: mainnet at
node1.tunnelsprotocol.org (JSON-RPC :9334). 10 Rust crates, WASM SDK, CLI
wallet, full node.

## Hard constraints — never violate, never "fix"
1. NO native token, block rewards, or protocol fees. Ever. (Rules 4, 14.)
2. NO continuous mining. Block production is event-driven: transaction
   acceptance triggers the block. Empty blocks are never produced.
3. NO key rotation, recovery, or delegated signing. Loss is permanent by design.
4. NO admin keys, governance, or upgrade paths. Evolution = new deployment.
5. Contributors never pay anything. Bonds come from applications, returned on
   finalization.
6. Verification windows: 24h protocol minimum. Longer allowed, shorter never.
7. On-chain data is hashes and protocol state only. No names, no content.
If a task seems to require violating these, the task is wrong, not the rules.
See docs/implementation-rules.md and docs/deliberately-absent.md — they are
constraints with the force of consensus rules.

## Behaviors that will surprise you
- Transactions are deterministic (Ed25519): identical fields + same key =
  identical tx id. Distinguish otherwise-identical registrations via
  evidence_hash, or they collide.
- Project ids and attestation ids are the first 20 bytes of the signed tx id.
- RPC naming is split: chain/mempool/mining/network methods are camelCase
  (getBlockCount, submitTransaction); protocol-state methods are snake_case
  (get_identity, get_project). Params are positional arrays.
- Timestamps come from consensus. Nothing can be backdated.
- The wallet accepts TUNNELS_WALLET_PASSWORD for non-interactive use;
  `import --yes` skips prompts.

## Core primitives
- Identity: non-transferable Ed25519 key pair (Human or Agent; Agent revenue
  routes to its parent Human)
- Project: immutable container — ρ reserve, φ fee, γ genesis, δ predecessor,
  window, bonds — all locked at registration
- Attestation: contributor-signed contribution record, bonded, subject to a
  challenge window; finalization is permissionless
- Revenue Router: deterministic waterfall (predecessor → reserve → fee →
  genesis → labor pool pro-rata by units)

## Integration pattern (the only sanctioned shape)
Applications embed the WASM SDK; contributors' keys are generated and sign in
their own browsers; the application server stores addresses only, never keys;
the application holds its own identity for acts it performs as itself
(deposits, finalization, adjudication); settlement is application-layer.
